drafts.order-1:
Important safety notice regarding your order (order-1).

The VEEKTOMX VT103 Mini Power Bank in this order is part of a recall announced by the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC): "Shenzhen Baihang Recalls VEEKTOMX Mini Power Banks, Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold on Amazon."

Official recall notice: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2026/Shenzhen-Baihang-Recalls-VEEKTOMX-Mini-Power-Banks-Due-to-Fire-and-Burn-Hazards-Sold-on-Amazon

This item matches the recalled product: VEEKTOMX VT103 Mini Power Bank with model number "VT103" on the back and no serial number on the bottom-right corner of the back.

What to do (per the official notice): Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled power banks and contact Shenzhen Baihang to verify the power bank is part of the recall and receive a free replacement power bank.

Disposal: Do not throw this recalled lithium-ion battery or device in the trash, in the general recycling stream (e.g., street-level or curbside recycling bins), or in used battery recycling boxes found at various retail and home improvement stores. Recalled lithium-ion batteries must be disposed of differently than other batteries because they present a greater risk of fire. Your municipal household hazardous waste (HHW) collection center may accept this recalled lithium-ion battery or device for disposal. Before taking your battery or device to a HHW collection center, contact that office ahead of time and ask whether it accepts recalled lithium-ion batteries. If it does not, contact your municipality for further guidance.

Your order has been paused while this recall is handled. We will follow up with next steps.
